title: Guard Clauses Handle Edge Cases First

contentBlocks.body: A guard clause checks for an invalid or empty case at the top of a function and returns early. Handling the edge case first keeps the main logic below it simple and avoids errors like dividing by zero.

payload.text: A guard clause returns ____ when an input is invalid so the rest of the function can assume good data.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return the average of the scores, or 0 when the array is empty.
